metadata.description: A personal Claude Code plugin library.

plugins.name: executive-assistant
plugins.description: ADHD-friendly executive assistant: a morning brief that remembers your email rules and plans the week, focus sessions with check-ins, an end-of-day shutdown, markdown tasks, and Day Desk, a local dashboard with chat. Gmail and Calendar via Google Workspace MCP, plus Slack, Jira, Linear and your notes folder.

plugins.name: voice-replies
plugins.description: Reads the main agent's replies aloud, rewritten for speech, with Kokoro on the GPU (or CPU). Sessions take turns instead of cutting each other off, each session keeps its own voice, and a reply that arrives while another session speaks waits for Play.

plugins.name: session-manager
plugins.description: Reviews your open Claude sessions and tells you which are stale, which wait on you, and which are done but not archived. Type /manager for a to-do list with one next step per session, then bulk archive stale ones with their worktrees.

plugins.name: session-brief
plugins.description: Shows a brief above the prompt: how the session started, where it left off, next steps and what you should know. Renames the session to say what the work is.

plugins.name: software-factory
plugins.description: An AI software factory. A CTO agent turns your goals into work for 14 role agents that plan, design, build, review and test code in git worktrees, in one repo or across a workspace of repos. Teams mapped to Linear teams, bug and tech-debt streams, cycles, baselines of work in flight, and CTO reports with improvement proposals. Human approval gates, proof-checked handoffs, token budgets, and a local control center with a kanban and a live org chart.
